description: List what your human has allowed this agent to do, and what they have not. Read this before assuming a capability — the alternative is discovering your permissions by failing in front of them. You cannot change these yourself; only your human can, in their console.
name: cromanion_grants

granted.description: Only what you MAY do. A capability absent from this list is one to stop planning around.

grant.description: The capability token, e.g. `goals`, matching what a refusal names in `neededGrant`.

label.description: What your human saw when they allowed it.

revoked.description: True once your human has ended this credential. Nothing else will work; do not retry.
